validation.initialFailureAndFix: The first 222-test run found the browser-side coverage calculation missing the newly recorded source-audit gap. Synchronized core calculation and exported report, and added a guard rejecting completion while source-audit tasks remain. A subsequent regeneration hit Windows UNKNOWN opening content-tasks.json; unchanged generated files are now skipped and transient write errors retried up to five attempts. The complete nine-artifact regeneration then passed byte-for-byte and all 222 tests passed. Production build passed. Source review was performed 2026-10-23; browser verification/publication resumed on client date 2026-10-24.
